generated.description: A large-scale replica of a space-needle style observation tower, standing on four legs with a wide quartz saucer-shaped top section and a slender central spire. Built mostly from gray wool, stone slabs, quartz blocks and glass, with glowstone accents and a few oak details. Roughly 53 by 53 blocks across and 185 blocks tall, with about 16,000 blocks in total; the observation deck is a rounded top ring with windows, and the inside is not documented.
